message.content:
Beneath the wide, unending sky,  
A ribbon of wind‑kissed dreams takes flight—  
A kite, a whisper in the blue,  
Dancing with the clouds, a fleeting sprite.

Its tail, a flag of colors bright,  
Sways like a heartbeat in the breeze;  
It arcs above the meadow’s light,  
A silver thread through rustling trees.

The string, a line of hope and thought,  
Pulls the heart toward horizons new;  
Each gust a lesson, each knot a plot,  
In the sky’s vast, open view.

When the wind grows wild and fierce,  
The kite leans, yet never breaks;  
It learns to bend, to twist, to pierce,  
The sky’s own breath, the earth’s own stakes.

And when the day begins to dim,  
The kite, a silhouette against the dusk,  
Holds the promise of tomorrow’s hymn,  
A silent vow that we will trust.

So let us lift our own small kites,  
With strings of courage, faith, and grace;  
For in the sky’s eternal heights,  
We find our place in time and space.
